prompt: Show a microservice order orchestration where a customer submits an order, the order service validates it, reserves inventory, authorizes payment, creates shipment, publishes events, and returns confirmation.
enzo:
sequence MicroserviceOrderOrchestration
actor Customer
participant Storefront
participant OrderService
participant CustomerService
participant InventoryService
participant PaymentService
participant ShippingService
participant EventBus
participant Database
Customer -> Storefront: Submit order
Storefront -> OrderService: Create order
OrderService -> CustomerService: Validate customer
CustomerService --> OrderService: Customer valid
OrderService -> Database: Save pending order
Database --> OrderService: Order id
OrderService -> InventoryService: Reserve inventory
InventoryService --> OrderService: Inventory reserved
OrderService -> PaymentService: Authorize payment
PaymentService --> OrderService: Payment authorized
OrderService -> ShippingService: Create shipment
ShippingService --> OrderService: Shipment created
OrderService -> EventBus: Publish order confirmed
EventBus --> OrderService: Event accepted
OrderService -> Database: Mark confirmed
Database --> OrderService: Order confirmed
OrderService --> Storefront: Confirmation
Storefront --> Customer: Show confirmation
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
actor Customer
participant Storefront
participant OrderService
participant CustomerService
participant InventoryService
participant PaymentService
participant ShippingService
participant EventBus
participant Database

Storefront->>OrderService: Create order
OrderService->>CustomerService: Validate customer
CustomerService-->>OrderService: Customer valid
OrderService->>Database: Save pending order
Database-->>OrderService: Order id
OrderService->>InventoryService: Reserve inventory
InventoryService-->>OrderService: Inventory reserved
OrderService->>PaymentService: Authorize payment
PaymentService-->>OrderService: Payment authorized
OrderService->>ShippingService: Create shipment
ShippingService-->>OrderService: Shipment created
OrderService->>EventBus: Publish order confirmed
EventBus-->>OrderService: Event accepted
OrderService->>Database: Mark confirmed
Database-->>OrderService: Order confirmed
OrderService-->>Storefront: Confirmation
Storefront-->>Customer: Show confirmation

EventBus -> InventoryConsumer: Deliver OrderPlaced
InventoryConsumer -> Coordinator: Report inventory reserved
Coordinator --> InventoryConsumer: Recorded
EventBus -> BillingConsumer: Deliver OrderPlaced
BillingConsumer -> Coordinator: Report invoice created
Coordinator --> BillingConsumer: Recorded
Coordinator -> OrderDatabase: Mark processing complete
OrderDatabase --> Coordinator: Updated
Coordinator -> NotificationService: Send confirmation
NotificationService --> Coordinator: Notification sent

prompt: Show an asynchronous job with callback where a client submits work, the API stores job state, a worker processes it, calls an external system, updates status, and a callback service notifies the client endpoint.
enzo:
sequence AsyncJobWithCallback
actor Client
participant Api
participant JobStore
participant Queue
participant Worker
participant ExternalSystem
participant CallbackService
participant ClientEndpoint
Client -> Api: Submit async job
Api -> JobStore: Save pending job
JobStore --> Api: Job id
Api -> Queue: Enqueue job
Queue --> Api: Enqueued
Api --> Client: 202 with job id
Queue -> Worker: Deliver job
Worker -> ExternalSystem: Execute work
ExternalSystem --> Worker: Work result
Worker -> JobStore: Mark complete
JobStore --> Worker: Status saved
Worker -> CallbackService: Request callback
CallbackService -> ClientEndpoint: POST job complete
ClientEndpoint --> CallbackService: Callback accepted
CallbackService --> Worker: Callback delivered
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
actor Client
participant Api
participant JobStore
participant Queue
participant Worker
participant ExternalSystem
participant CallbackService
participant ClientEndpoint

JobStore-->>Api: Job id

prompt: Show an integration platform synchronizing customer records from a source SaaS to a target SaaS with token refresh, paging, transformation, upsert, retry on rate limit, checkpointing, and audit logging.

participant SyncOrchestrator
participant TokenService
participant SourceSaas
participant Transformer
participant TargetSaas
participant CheckpointStore
participant AuditLog

TokenService --> SyncOrchestrator: Source token
SyncOrchestrator -> SourceSaas: Fetch customer page

SyncOrchestrator -> Transformer: Map records
Transformer --> SyncOrchestrator: Target payloads
SyncOrchestrator -> TargetSaas: Upsert customers
TargetSaas --> SyncOrchestrator: 429 rate limit

AuditLog --> SyncOrchestrator: Audit id

TargetSaas --> SyncOrchestrator: Upsert accepted

CheckpointStore --> SyncOrchestrator: Checkpoint saved
SyncOrchestrator -> AuditLog: Record sync complete

SyncOrchestrator --> Scheduler: Sync complete
